# Psalm 37 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Of-David. Do-not fret because-of evildoers; do-not be-envious of-those-doing injustice.

**2** For like-grass quickly they-wither, and-like-green herbage they-fade.

**3** Trust in-YHWH and-do good; dwell [in] the-land and-tend faithfulness.

**4** And-delight-yourself in-YHWH, and-He-will-give you the-desires of-your-heart.

**5** Commit to-YHWH your-way, and-trust in-Him, and-He will-act.

**6** And-He-will-bring-forth as-the-light your-righteousness, and-your-justice as-the-noonday.

**7** Be-still before-YHWH and-wait-patiently for-Him; do-not fret over-the-one-who-prospers in-his-way, over-the-man carrying-out evil-schemes.

**8** Cease from-anger and-forsake wrath; do-not fret — it-leads only to-evil.

**9** For evildoers shall-be-cut-off, but-those-waiting-for YHWH — they shall-inherit the-land.

**10** And-yet a-little while and-the-wicked [is] no-more; you-look-carefully at-his-place, and-he [is] not-there.

**11** But-the-humble shall-inherit the-land and-delight in-abundance of-peace.

**12** The-wicked plots against-the-righteous and-gnashes at-him [with] his-teeth.

**13** The-Lord laughs at-him, for He-sees that his-day is-coming.

**14** A-sword the-wicked have-drawn and-have-bent their-bow, to-bring-down the-afflicted and-needy, to-slaughter the-upright of-way.

**15** Their-sword shall-enter their-own heart, and-their-bows shall-be-broken.

**16** Better [is] the-little of-the-righteous than-the-abundance of-many wicked.

**17** For the-arms of-the-wicked shall-be-broken, but-YHWH upholds the-righteous.

**18** YHWH knows the-days of-the-blameless, and-their-inheritance shall-be forever.

**19** They-shall-not be-put-to-shame in-time of-evil, and-in-the-days of-famine they-shall-be-satisfied.

**20** For the-wicked shall-perish, and-the-enemies of-YHWH [are] like-the-glory of-the-pastures — they-vanish; in-smoke they-vanish.

**21** The-wicked borrows and-does-not repay, but-the-righteous is-gracious and-gives.

**22** For those-blessed by-Him shall-inherit the-land, but-those-cursed by-Him shall-be-cut-off.

**23** By-YHWH the-steps of-a-man are-established, and-in-his-way He-delights.

**24** Though he-falls, he-shall-not be-hurled-down, for YHWH sustains his-hand.

**25** Young I-was, and-now I-am-old, and-I-have-not seen the-righteous forsaken, and-his-seed begging bread.

**26** All the-day he-is-gracious and-lends, and-his-seed [is] for-a-blessing.

**27** Turn from-evil and-do good, and-dwell forevermore.

**28** For YHWH loves justice and-does-not forsake His-faithful-ones; forever they-are-preserved, but-the-seed of-the-wicked is-cut-off.

**29** The-righteous shall-inherit the-land and-dwell upon-it forever.

**30** The-mouth of-the-righteous utters wisdom, and-his-tongue speaks justice.

**31** The-Torah of-his-God [is] in-his-heart; his-steps do-not slip.

**32** The-wicked watches for-the-righteous and-seeks to-kill-him.

**33** YHWH does-not abandon-him in-his-hand and-does-not condemn-him when-he-is-judged.

**34** Wait for-YHWH and-keep His-way, and-He-will-exalt-you to-inherit the-land; when-the-wicked are-cut-off, you-will-see [it].

**35** I-have-seen the-wicked ruthless, and-spreading like-a-luxuriant native-tree.

**36** And-he-passed-away, and-behold he-was-not; and-I-sought-him and-he-was-not found.

**37** Observe the-blameless and-see the-upright, for [there is] a-future for-the-man of-peace.

**38** But-transgressors shall-be-destroyed together; the-future of-the-wicked shall-be-cut-off.

**39** And-the-salvation of-the-righteous [is] from-YHWH, their-stronghold in-time of-distress.

**40** And-YHWH helps-them and-delivers-them; He-delivers-them from-the-wicked and-saves-them, because they-take-refuge in-Him.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **37:11**: 'The meek shall inherit the land' — Jesus quotes this in the Beatitudes (Matt 5:5), expanding 'land' to 'earth.' The psalm's promise becomes global.

— EMET
